title: Alembic migrations (single initial revision, regenerated in one command)
API_contract: alembic upgrade head on an empty PostgreSQL produces exactly the models' schema (compare_metadata == []) and is idempotent; env.py uses app.main.discover_modules and settings.database_url; autogenerate also emits CREATE SEQUENCE (order_number_seq)
migration: Initial revision must be regenerated (scripts/regen-initial-migration.sh) whenever a module adds models before first release; the test fails on drift
remaining_risks: Revision currently reflects the models present when last regenerated; other owners' later models fail test_migrations until the lead regenerates
downgrade() of the initial revision is autogenerated and untested on data
No data migrations exist yet

title: Backups: pg_dump + media, AES-256-GCM, sha256 manifest, retention, scheduled job, restore drill
API_contract: GET/POST /api/system/backups, POST /{id}/verify-restore, GET /{id}/download, DELETE /{id}; system.read to list, system.manage to create/verify/download/delete; CLI python -m app.modules.ops.backup create|verify|list|restore
migration: uses existing backups table (platform.models.BackupRecord); settings group Backups (backup.*)
remaining_risks: Backups live on the same disk unless the operator copies them off-server (documented, not automated)
Verified on small databases only (<1000 rows, <300 KB); no large-database timing
pg_dump/pg_restore must be installed and CREATEDB granted for drills
Scheduled job verified by calling the job function, not by waiting for the worker loop
Encrypted backups depend on the vault key; rotating it requires keeping the old key (ADR 0007)

title: System → Backups tab (prerequisites, last success/verification, run, verify, download, delete)
remaining_risks: Type-checks (tsc strict) but has NOT been exercised in a browser: layout, mobile, drawer, polling, download link are unverified
No component tests

title: Vault key rotation CLI (re-seal all *_sealed columns, all-or-nothing, verify)
API_contract: python -m app.modules.ops.vault rotate --old-key-env X --new-key-env Y [--apply] | verify
remaining_risks: Tested on synthetic data only, never rehearsed on a real installation
Single-key design: no zero-downtime rotation / key ring (ADR 0007)
Older encrypted backups need the old key

title: Legacy MongoDB → PostgreSQL importer (dry-run, idempotent apply, reconciliation)
API_contract: CLI python -m app.modules.migration import --source DIR [--prefix v1_] [--apply] [--report f.json]; GET /api/system/migration/runs (system.manage)
migration: legacy_id_map + legacy_import_runs tables; legacy_id columns on stores/users/customers/categories/products/variants
remaining_risks: Real-data smoke test covered 56 products / 112 variants / 2 orders / 2 users / 1 coupon from a freshly seeded legacy instance, not a production database
No importer for reviews, support threads, gift cards, affiliates, loyalty/credit, returns, themes/documents, media binaries
Order STATUS_MAP assumes the commerce module's status vocabulary; adjust when it is finalised
Legacy order access links cannot be preserved
Signed-in customer orders, refunds, coupon redemptions covered only by synthetic fixtures
No admin UI (CLI only)
